best_idea: When the player commits a zone change, fade a world map in over 0.5 s, keep it up for 5 s, and glide its centre from the current zone toward the midpoint of the current and destination zones over 2.5 s.
decision_why: A client-only zone-travel preview fits the HUD (row 14) and zones as data. Keep the glide and the linger, count in seconds with delta time, and drop the galaxy-only parts. The map must show what the server says, not decide the route.
acceptance: Tapping travel on a zone link fades the world map in within 0.5 s; its centre slides over about 2.5 s from the current zone to the midpoint; it fades out during the last 0.5 s of its 5 s; cancelling the travel keeps the destination marked until the 5 s is up.
